== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Navigators are a specialized [[Guild]] within the [[Elder Empire]], serving as foundational architects and long-term stewards of its people. They are known for their extreme secrecy, often guarding their knowledge more intensely than other groups like the [[Champions]]. As a [[Guild]], they play significant political roles, having previously held the [[Imperial]] Palace and attempted to access the [[Optasia]]. The Navigators are defined by their mastery of the [[Aion Sea]] through the use of [[Vessels]]. These unique ships are constructed using parts of [[Elders]] or [[Elderspawn]], which allows the vessel to guide its captain through hazardous deep waters. A [[Navigator]] is a [[Soulbound]] individual who shares a profound connection with their ship, effectively controlling the vessel as an extension of their own body. While most [[Navigator ships]] are small craft operated by a single [[Soulbound]] captain and a minimal crew, they possess an uncanny ability to navigate difficult environments. Notable figures include [[Cheska Bennett]] and [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]], the latter of whom utilized a [[Navigator]]'s [[Vessel]] to ascend to the position of Emperor.}}
